summary: Darden Studio's product page for Halyard, a three-optical-size grotesque (Micro, Text, Display), built as a buying tool: an illustrated cargo-plane hero whose 'Halyard Display' livery is editable, a black strip of every style name set in itself, a masonry of tester cards with per-card controls, an About spec sheet, an auto-scrolling In Use carousel and an on-page cart (style matrix plus licence calculator). A cookie banner and the sticky nav are stamped over most crops; the Features & Glyphs and Languages drawers were not captured.

instances.look: Darden Studio's 64px white site bar: 'Darden Studio' wordmark left, 'MENU' right

Sticky 64px Halyard bar: black block with the d logo and 'Halyard®', grey anchors TESTER · ABOUT · IN USE, a purple block with FEATURES & GLYPHS · LANGUAGES (drawer toggles), green Fontstand and orange Adobe Fonts icon squares, and a yellow 'Buy' block

Flat vector scene of a white cargo jet with a purple tail on a motorway overpass, 'Halyard Display' in yellow Black across its fuselage, two purple German autobahn signs (Hannover, Kassel, Dortmund… / Köln, Wiesbaden, München) set in Halyard, giant cyan and purple outlined letter shapes behind
instances.ux: The fuselage title is editable (type to repaint the livery); a 'Play with the type' corner button opens a panel; Buy sits in the sticky bar above
instances.learn: Make the hero's brand name an editable text field inside the illustration, so the first thing a visitor can do is see their own word on the plane

reconstruction.layout: Full-width SVG, aspect 1370:435 (≈1440×457) under two 64px bars; the editable title sits in a foreignObject at x=250, y=260, 1100×180 (viewBox units) over the fuselage; signs lower right ~220×120 each
reconstruction.typography: Fuselage title ~75px Halyard Display Black, yellow #fcd306; sign text ~11px Halyard Text white on purple with arrow pictograms
reconstruction.behaviour: contenteditable='plaintext-only' span with placeholder 'Halyard Display' inside the SVG; heroPanel toggle ('Play with the type', data-open) reveals an extra control panel (not captured)
reconstruction.content: Aviation and autobahn signage theme; real German place names
reconstruction.assets: Inline SVG illustration (plane, overpass, signs, big outlined letter shapes)
reconstruction.html: #Hero svg[data-hero-svg] > foreignObject#editableText[data-hero-fo] > .editableTitle_wrap > span.editableTitle_title[contenteditable=plaintext-only][data-placeholder]; .heroPanel_root[data-open] > button.heroPanel_trigger[aria-label='Play with the type']

instances.look: A black band under the hero with three rows labelled MICRO / TEXT / DISPLAY, each a single line of the style names in their own style: 'Extralight Light Book Regular Medium Semibold Bold Black — Extralight Light Book… (italics)', running off the right edge
instances.ux: Each row scrolls sideways; every style name is contenteditable, so visitors can retype any name and compare the three optical sizes
instances.learn: Stack the optical sizes as three lines of the same weight names: the difference between Micro, Text and Display shows at a glance without a table

reconstruction.layout: Black band ~190px; label column ~80px at x≈60 (10px caps grey); three rows ~40px apart, each a horizontal scroll container of 16 inline spans
reconstruction.typography: ~22px white Halyard Micro VF / Text VF / Display VF with font-variation-settings 'wght' 100–900 per span; italics via the VF Italic files; labels ~10px caps tracked, grey
reconstruction.behaviour: Horizontal overflow scroll per row; contenteditable span per style (data-original-name keeps the default)

instances.look: A masonry of five white tester cards on light grey, each in its own colour: 'Black' at 260px in green Display Black, 'No. 24' in orange Micro Black Italic, the sentence 'Whenever the black fox jumped the squirrel gazed suspiciously.' in purple Text, a pink paragraph on legibility vs readability, a green italic paragraph on visual relationships; small dropdowns (optical size, style) top-left of each card, reset and add-to-cart icons at the bottom
instances.ux: Per card: pick Micro/Text/Display and one of 16 styles, switch the sample between Word / Sentence / Pangram / Paragraph, drag size (12–260px), tracking (-0.1–0.3em) and leading (0.8–2); type over the text; ↻ resets and the cart icon adds that style to the cart
instances.learn: Give each tester card a content-length preset (word → paragraph) and an add-to-cart button: the tester becomes the first step of buying the style you just tried

reconstruction.layout: Grid ~1440×1261, cards in 2–3 columns of varying height with ~16px light-grey gutters; text auto-fits each card (height checker); controls in a thin strip at the card top and icons bottom-right
reconstruction.typography: Card 1: 260px Halyard Display VF wght 900; card 2: ~150px Halyard Micro VF Italic wght 900; card 3: ~36px Halyard Text Book; paragraphs ~22px Text Light / Light Italic, leading 1.2–1.4; controls ~12px Halyard Text
reconstruction.behaviour: MUI selects (subfamily, style, content preset) and three MUI sliders per card (size 12–260 step 0.1, tracking -0.1–0.3 step 0.01, leading 0.8–2 step 0.1) set inline font-size, letter-spacing, line-height and font-variation-settings 'wght'; contenteditable span per card; heightChecker keeps the sample inside the card
reconstruction.content: Style names, 'No. 24', a pangram ('Whenever the black fox jumped the squirrel gazed suspiciously.') and paragraphs about legibility and readability
reconstruction.html: #Tester .typefaceShowcase_* card > select(Micro|Text|Display) + select(16 styles) + select(Word|Sentence|Pangram|Paragraph) + input[type=range] ×3 + span.typeContainer.styleTarget[contenteditable]

WOFF2 Size 47kb, Version 1.0.1, then Origin, Designers Joshua Darden, Eben Sorkin, Lucas Sharp, assistants, management, media) beside 'Halyard — Surprising & Useful' in Gamay and a short paragraph on its 19th-century sources (Schelter+Giesecke, Miller and Richard, Morris Fuller Benton) with a pink 'Show More'; a purple bar below with 'Features & Glyphs' and 'Languages' buttons; yellow blob and outlined letter shapes in the background

instances.learn: Put the spec facts a buyer checks (styles, classification, file size, version, credits) in a fixed sidebar next to a one-paragraph origin story with 'Show More'

instances.look: Two slow-moving strips of real uses: the 'Wander Lust' fall launch photo with a compass-frame logo, an orange shipping container, Antonio Cavedoni's map of Italy, the Future Now USA poster, African American Design Nexus, each captioned in small caps ('FUTURE NOW USA, 2017')
instances.ux: The carousels drift continuously (free-mode swiper, right-to-left, 20s transitions); each item has an 'Enlarge this example' button
instances.learn: Let real-world uses drift past on their own and offer enlarge on click: social proof without demanding attention

reconstruction.layout: Strip of images ~450px tall with ~30px gaps starting under the About section, then a second ~200px strip with captions; images keep their aspect (max-aspect ~2:1)
reconstruction.behaviour: Swiper free mode, dir=rtl, transition-duration 20000ms for continuous drift; enlarge buttons open a lightbox

instances.look: '① Select Styles': a matrix with purple weight labels (Extralight → Black) down the left, colour-coded column headers MICRO (cyan) / TEXT (yellow) / DISPLAY (pink), each with roman and italic columns, every cell the word 'Halyard' in that style on grey; an 'All + VAR' toggle top-left. '② Choose License': four licence columns (Basic License: CPUs + Perpetual; Web Embedding: AMPVs + term; App Embedding: AMAUs; Fluid Interface: AMRUs) with dropdowns; a black bar 'Please select a style/license' in yellow at the bottom
instances.ux: Click cells (or whole rows/columns, or 'All + VAR' for the variable fonts) to add styles; set usage tiers per licence type; the black bar shows the total or the prompt
instances.learn: Let the buyer pick styles from a matrix that is also the family overview, then size the licence by usage metrics; the price bar updates in place

reconstruction.layout: ~1410px tall; step headings with a yellow number disc; matrix 1440 wide: 120px label column + 6 columns ~220px, header row ~36px, 8 rows ~72px, white 2px borders; licence row 4 columns ~330px with selects ~150×28; black total bar ~70px full width
reconstruction.typography: Step headings ~30px Gamay purple; cells ~22px Halyard in each style; labels ~11px Halyard Text white on purple; total bar text ~22px Gamay yellow right-aligned
reconstruction.behaviour: Cell click toggles selection (highlight); selects for user tiers (0 CPUs, 0 AMPVs, 0 AMAUs, 0 AMRUs) and term (Perpetual, 1 year…); total recalculates
reconstruction.html: #Buy: h2 '1 Select Styles' + 'All + VAR' toggle + style matrix; h2 '2 Choose License' + 4 × select pairs; total bar
